# GitHub repository metadata

Paste these into **Settings → General** (description, website) and the **About**
panel on the repository home page (topics). Kept here so the two stay in sync
with the README.

## Description

> Web tracker for the card games we play in person — rounds, standings and
> money owed, kept in one database so the statistics write themselves. Angular
> + Spring Boot.

Short form, if the above runs long in the About panel:

> Central database and statistics for our pen-and-paper card nights. Angular +
> Spring Boot.

## Checkboxes

- Releases, Packages, Deployments: off — nothing is published.
- Issues: on.
- Discussions: off unless someone asks for it.
- Private vulnerability reporting: **on** (Settings → Advanced Security).
